user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features
user_agents.scope: Search indexing for ChatGPT search results

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT
user_agents.scope: Ad landing pages submitted by advertisers; data not used for model training

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Training data collection for generative AI foundation models
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for model training and safety improvements

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: User-triggered fetch for live responses to ChatGPT questions
user_agents.scope: User-initiated page visits in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs; not automatic crawling
user_agents.opt_out: robots.txt rules may not apply; user-triggered action

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathering web content for AI model development and training
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for model training datasets
user_agents.opt_out: Add 'User-agent: ClaudeBot' with 'Disallow: /' to robots.txt; supports Crawl-delay directive

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieve web content when Claude AI users ask questions
user_agents.scope: User-triggered web fetches in response to user queries to Claude

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search result quality and relevance for users
user_agents.scope: Web crawl to index content for search optimization and accuracy

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Building Google Search indexes and related product crawls
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for Google Search, Images, Video, News, and Discover

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawling images for Google Images and Search features
user_agents.scope: Image URLs for Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search image features

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawling videos for video-related Google Search features
user_agents.scope: Video content for Google Search video features and dependent products

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawling content for Google News product
user_agents.scope: Content for Google News, news.google.com, and Google News app

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawling product information for Google Shopping
user_agents.scope: Product data for Google Shopping tab and Google Shopping surfaces

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Testing and inspection for Search Console tools
user_agents.scope: Fetches for Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling for internal research and development
user_agents.scope: One-off crawls for various product teams fetching public content

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Generic image crawling for internal product teams
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs for various internal research purposes

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Generic video crawling for internal product teams
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs for various internal research purposes

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawling for building Vertex AI Agents requested by site owners
user_agents.scope: Content crawls requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agent building

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Training data collection for Gemini models and grounding
user_agents.scope: Manages content usage for Gemini Apps and Vertex AI API training and grounding

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface and link websites in Perplexity search results
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for search indexing; not used for AI training data collection
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: PerplexityBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt; verify IP ranges against https://www.perplexity.com/perplexitybot.json

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user-triggered web fetches to provide accurate answers to user questions
user_agents.scope: User-requested page visits to gather information for answering questions; generally ignores robots.txt
user_agents.opt_out: Block via WAF using User-Agent header matching and IP ranges from https://www.perplexity.com/perplexity-user.json

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology integrated into Spotlight, Siri, and Safari to make website content discoverable for Apple users
user_agents.scope: General web crawl across Apple ecosystem for search indexing and rendering content
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt via 'User-agent: Applebot' directive. Respects standard robots.txt rules and robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Determines content eligibility for training Apple foundation models powering generative AI features like Apple Intelligence
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; only evaluates data already crawled by Applebot for AI training use
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt via 'User-agent: Applebot-Extended Disallow: /' to opt out of generative AI training

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content registered on Apple Podcasts for indexing and discovery
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered Apple Podcasts content
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt directives as it is not a general search crawler

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content shared on Meta's family of apps to gather title, description, and thumbnail image
user_agents.scope: Content from apps or websites shared on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger; may bypass robots.txt for security checks
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: facebookexternalhit / Disallow: / (may bypass robots.txt for security or integrity checks)

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality and enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI responses
user_agents.scope: Web crawl to analyze online content for Meta AI search capabilities

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improve advertising and other business-related products and services
user_agents.scope: Web crawl for advertising and business product improvement

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Train foundation AI models and improve products by indexing content directly
user_agents.scope: Web crawl for AI model training and product improvement via content indexing

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch individual links at user request to support agentic AI capabilities for task completion
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for evaluating and improving agentic AI; may bypass robots.txt
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: meta-externalfetcher / Disallow: / (may bypass robots.txt for user-requested fetches)

user_agents.name: Copilot
user_agents.purpose: AI training and live web search for Copilot features
user_agents.scope: General web crawling for training data and real-time information retrieval

user_agents.name: ADSBot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Ad-related crawling for Microsoft Advertising
user_agents.scope: Web crawling for advertising purposes

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve Amazon products and services; train Amazon AI models
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for product improvement and AI model training
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Amazonbot / Disallow: / in robots.txt; honors robots meta tags noarchive, noindex, none

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services
user_agents.scope: Index content for search results in Alexa and Rufus; does not crawl for generative AI training
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Amzn-SearchBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt; honors robots meta tags noarchive, noindex, none

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user-triggered actions requiring up-to-date information for Alexa responses
user_agents.scope: Fetch live information on-demand for user queries; does not crawl for generative AI training
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Amzn-User / Disallow: / in robots.txt; honors robots meta tags noarchive, noindex, none

user_agents.name: CCBot/2.0
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling for Common Crawl dataset collection
user_agents.scope: General web crawl, samples of websites indexed for public research and analysis
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: CCBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt file, or use Crawl-delay parameter

user_agents.name: CCBot/1.0
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling for Common Crawl dataset collection (older version)
user_agents.scope: General web crawl, samples of websites indexed for public research and analysis

user_agents.name: Agentic crawlers (generic)
user_agents.purpose: AI training, content indexing, and autonomous agent operations
user_agents.scope: General web crawl targeting content for AI model training and agent decision-making
user_agents.opt_out: robots.txt disallow rules; HTTP 402 Payment Required via Pay-Per-Crawl; Redirects for AI Training feature to canonical URLs

user_agents.name: Verified AI crawlers (Cloudflare terminology)
user_agents.purpose: Training data collection and content indexing with verification mechanisms
user_agents.scope: Crawls targeting verified AI training sources; subject to redirection to canonical content
user_agents.opt_out: Redirects for AI Training feature enforces canonical URL routing for verified crawlers
